title: The Call from the Core of the Ruins
next_chapter_hook: As the echoes within the seal gradually faded, a familiar and chilling voice emerged from the depths—Chen Xuan's voice, yet carrying an unprecedented weariness and desolation: 'Chen Ji... you've finally come.'

text.content: At the end of the dim corridor stood a massive stone gate, its surface carved with patterns eerily similar to the runes on the Tianji Record Fragment, glowing with a诡异的 blue light. Chen Ji stopped and gazed, his brow furrowed—the alignment between these patterns and the fragment in his hand far exceeded any of his previous estimates. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out in his mind: 'This is the place.'

Chen Ji slowly retrieved the Tianji Record Fragment from his chest. In the eerie light, the yellowed paper revealed fine cracks, those fissures trembling at an incredible frequency like fragments of memories sliced by time. The runes on the gate began to pulse as well, the two's glows echoing across the distance, as if a beast slumbering for ten thousand years was slowly opening its eyes.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a rare gravity) 'Be careful. This seal is connected to your Heavenly Fate. Uncarefully opening it may trigger unforeseen consequences. However... this is also the only lead you currently have to find the complete Tianji Record.'

text.content: Chen Ji pressed the fragment against the stone gate. The moment his fingertips touched the cold granite surface, a majestic stream of information flooded into his Mental Sea like a tide. It was a torrent of intertwined images—ancient cultivators crossing tribulations in magnificent scenes, brutal片段s of the war between immortals and demons, and more—a blurred figure walking alone in endless darkness, the figure's back solitary and resolute.

The cracks on the fragment suddenly vibrated violently, and a line of crimson ancient seal characters emerged on the paper's surface—'The Nine Scrolls of Heavenly Secrets, scattered across the eight wastelands; only by gathering nine pages can the true chapter be seen.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, which meant the fragment in his hand was far from enough. The runes on the stone gate began to rotate, a thin crack appearing in the center of the gate, through which a thread of golden light leaked.

choice.prompt: Faced with this thin crack and the golden light within, Chen Ji needed to make a choice: attempt to open more seals with the existing fragment, or act cautiously and first gather more fragment information?

choices.description: Completely embed the fragment into the crack, attempting to forcibly open the seal by using his Heavenly Fate as the cost. Extremely high risk, but may obtain first-hand clues.
choices.visible_reward: May obtain key clues to the complete Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption is uncontrollable, dangers within the seal are unknown

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, slowly pushing the fragment into the crack. The contact point between the fragment and the stone gate erupted with blinding golden light, a violent energy fluctuation instantly shredding his spiritual awareness into fragments. In the moment his consciousness was about to scatter, he saw it—the solitary figure turned around, revealing a face bearing a seventy percent resemblance to his own. 'Brother...' the person softly called, the voice carrying infinite remorse and longing.

Chen Ji was violently ejected several zhang away, his back slamming heavily against the rock wall, a mouthful of blood gushing out. The violent consumption of Heavenly Fate left his face as pale as paper, but his eyes burned with extraordinary intensity—that image, that voice, he was certain he hadn't misheard. Chen Xuan... his older brother, truly existed somewhere in this world.

choices.description: Not rushing to open the seal, but stepping back to carefully observe the overall structure of the stone gate, attempting to decode more information from the outside. Time-consuming, but safer.
choices.visible_cost: Consume time, may miss the opportunity
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete information on the seal structure, reduce subsequent risks
choices.risk_hint: There may be other coveters of the ruins, delay may cause missed opportunities

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully suppressed the impulse in his heart, stepping back three paces, and began to carefully examine every detail of the stone gate. The runes on the gate were not chaotic but arranged according to some profound pattern—Kan, Gen, Zhen, Xun, Li, Kun, Dui, Qian, the positions of the Eight Trigrams hidden within. And in the very center of the stone gate, the shape of a recess was clearly visible: the Nine Palace Grid.

Chen Ji's heart stirred with excitement. He took out the fragment from his chest for comparison. Indeed, the fragment's size perfectly matched one of the palaces in the Nine Palace Grid. This meant opening the seal was not an overnight matter, but required gathering nine fragments to be inserted in a specific order. A slight smile curved Chen Ji's lips—though slower by half a step, this was the rhythm he was familiar with.

Just then, the golden light behind the stone gate suddenly fluctuated violently, an invisible suction emerging from the door's seam, making the fragment in Chen Ji's hand buzz and tremble. Mo Xiansheng's voice abruptly tensed: 'Not good, something inside the seal has sensed your presence! Decide quickly!'

dialogue.content: Just as Chen Ji's thoughts raced, a blurred voice came from deep within the stone gate, mournful like a plea, and fragmented like a delirious whisper: 'Brother... brother... is... it... you...' Though the voice was so faint it was barely identifiable, it exploded in Chen Ji's mind like thunder—it was Chen Nian's voice, his missing sister of many years!

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Beneath his calm features, a long-suppressed rage churned in his chest. Chen Nian... why would she be here? Didn't the Holy Sect say they had imprisoned her deep within the Forbidden Grounds? Could this all have been a trap from the very beginning? His fingers trembled slightly, the pull between reason and emotion casting him into unprecedented torment.

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's voice pushed Chen Ji's rationality to the brink of collapse—whether to heed Mo Xiansheng's advice to retreat temporarily and plan carefully, or to charge at the seal without hesitation to save his sister?

choices.description: Break through the seal at any cost, forcing open the stone door. Chen Nian's voice is right in front of him—there is no reason to back down.
choices.visible_cost: May deplete the Heavenly Fate, triggering the seal's backlash
choices.visible_reward: Rescue Chen Nian at the first opportunity
choices.risk_hint: Forcing a breakthrough in the current state promises ill fortune

text.content: Chen Ji let out a guttural roar, his hands gripping the fragment tightly as true essence surged madly through his body. Desperately, he pressed the fragment against the stone door, and his Heavenly Fate poured out like a breached dam. Golden and azure light collided violently. Chen Ji felt his divine consciousness being torn apart by a terrifying force, the intense pain almost driving him to lose consciousness.

choices.description: Force himself to calm down, memorize this location, then retreat temporarily. Plan carefully and return with a thorough strategy.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the optimal timing to rescue Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, leaving room for future actions
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian's situation may deteriorate sharply

text.content: Chen Ji's fingernails dug deep into his palms, blood dripping through his fingers. Every cell screamed to rush in, but his remaining rationality死死 pressed down this impulse. He memorized the stone door's location, the direction from which Chen Nian's voice came, then turned to walk back the way he came. His steps were as heavy as walking on blade tips, each stride carving deep marks into his heart.

Chen Ji made a silent vow in his heart: 'Xiao Nian, wait for your brother. This time, I will make absolutely thorough preparations to rescue you.' Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying rare praise: 'Excellent. This is how one who can laugh到最后笑的人 acts.'

However, the moment Chen Ji turned around, the runes on the stone door suddenly lit up, and a line of ancient text appeared on the door—'When the Nine Palaces open, Heavenly Secrets reunite; only those with Heaven's mandate may enter this gate.' Immediately after, a low rumble came from within the seal, and the entire ruins trembled slightly, as if some massive being was awakening.

Mo Xiansheng's voice turned urgent: 'Not good, this seal has autonomous consciousness! It sensed the connection between your bloodline and Chen Nian, and is attempting to establish some kind of channel! Run! Once the channel opens, it will expose your location!' Before he finished speaking, the golden light on the stone door suddenly condensed into a beam of light, shooting directly toward Chen Ji.

choice.prompt: The golden light pillar is about to strike Chen Ji—he must make his final reaction: to hard counter this beam and probe its information, or to dodge with all his strength to preserve himself?

choices.description: Bet everything to catch this light pillar, even if injured, to see the information it contains. The risk is extreme, but it may yield crucial intelligence.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain detailed information from within the seal
choices.risk_hint: The nature of the light pillar is unknown and may cause serious harm

text.content: Chen Ji did not dodge. Instead, he spread his arms wide and welcomed the golden light pillar. The moment the glow touched his skin, a scalding current of energy flowed through his entire body, and countless images flashed before his eyes like a carousel—he saw young Chen Nian being forcibly taken away by Holy Sect cultivators, witnessed Chen Xuan's final moment battling the heavenly tribulation alone in the ruins, and most importantly, saw the location of the complete Tianji Record: deep within the seal itself.

choices.description: Sidestep at the fastest speed to evade the light pillar, preserving strength. The light pillar will leave traces on the stone door, which can be studied later.
choices.visible_cost: Missing the opportunity to obtain information in real time
choices.risk_hint: Information acquisition may not be complete

text.content: Chen Ji's form shifted sideways like a specter, three chi away, as the golden beam of light whistled past his sleeve, blasting a bottomless hole into the rock wall behind him. He turned back to see that after the light dissipated, a clear line of runes remained on the stone door—a decoded message pointing to the unlocking sequence of the Nine Palace Seal.

Regardless of Chen Ji's choice, the runes on the stone door had already dimmed, and the seal had fallen into slumber once more. But Chen Ji knew this was far from over—Chen Nian was behind that seal, Chen Xuan's clues lay within, and the secret of the complete Tianji Record awaited his discovery.

Just as Chen Ji turned to leave the ruins, his footsteps suddenly halted. The Tianji Record Fragment in his arms, previously silent, grew faintly warm again. A weak spiritual fluctuation came through—it was Chen Nian's aura, mixed with fear, anticipation, and... a trace of intangible apology. As if she knew something, yet could not speak.

Chen Ji pressed the fragment tightly against his chest, murmuring softly: "Little Nian, whatever scheme lies within, your brother will rescue you." His gaze was calm as an ancient well, but the undercurrents surging beneath that calm were enough to make anyone who underestimated him pay the price. Mo Xiansheng sighed within the fragment: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao has begun to notice you... The road ahead will grow even more arduous."

The moment Chen Ji stepped out of the ruins, the sky outside had already deepened into twilight. He glanced back at the entrance hidden within the mountain wall, carving every detail into his memory. Ling Yuan's shadow of deep scheming had yet to fade, the scrutiny of the Eye of Heavenly Dao pricked like thorns, and now another Holy Sect conspiracy and Chen Nian's safety had been added—these chess pieces, he would settle accounts with one by one.

Just as Chen Ji was about to leave the valley, a gentle breeze brushed past, carrying a faint, ethereal fragrance. His body instantly tensed—this scent was all too familiar to him, the distinctive aroma of the Demonic Path's "Erosion Bone Orchid." Immediately after, a crisp laugh rang out from the shadows: "Young Master Chen, long time no see. I never expected you to find this place. It seems our potential for cooperation has increased severalfold."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing stepped slowly from the shadows, her black dress appearing especially bewitching in the twilight. Her gaze fell upon Chen Ji's noticeably pale face, a playful curve tugging at her lips: "It seems Young Master Chen endured quite some hardship in there? But never mind, I happen to have a clue regarding the whereabouts of the Tianji Record Fragment. I wonder if Young Master Chen would be interested in hearing it?" Deep within her eyes flickered an unnoticeable hint of seriousness, clearly not merely probing.

text.content: Chen Ji stared expressionlessly at this uninvited Demonic Path Saint, but in his heart, he was calculating rapidly. The intelligence that Ye Qing's "Demonic Path Miasma" could conceal the Tianji Record's aura was something he had long known, and her appearance here at this moment was no coincidence. He needed this lead, but he also had to guard against the Holy Sect forces behind her—though these two names differed by only one character, they represented entirely different power blocs.

Ye Qing seemed to see through Chen Ji's thoughts, chuckling softly as she proactively tossed a jade slip: "This is a deposit. Three days from now, at the Xuanwu Sect market, someone will be selling the second page of the Tianji Record Fragment. As for how Young Master Chen obtains it, that is your own affair." Her form began to fade away gradually, leaving only words floating in the wind: "We are on the same boat, Young Master Chen. I hope you won't disappoint me."

Chen Ji caught the jade slip, his spiritual sense probing into it—the detailed information regarding the fragment transaction was indeed recorded within. The corner of his mouth lifted slightly—this vixen Ye Qing truly never made a losing deal. Her goodwill in taking the initiative must conceal ulterior motives, but for now, he indeed needed this piece. As for what she truly wanted... Chen Ji was not in a hurry; he had plenty of time to slowly dissect it.

The night deepened, and Chen Ji stood alone in the valley, today's various discoveries echoing in his mind. The Nine Palace Seal's unlocking sequence, the truth of fragment resonance, Chen Nian's trapped location, Ye Qing's new lead... these seemingly scattered puzzle pieces were gradually forming a complete picture in his mind. He raised his head toward the countless stars in the sky, murmuring to himself: "Chen Xuan, what kind of chess game are you arranging?"

Deep within the ruins, that stone door fell into deathly silence once more. But just within this stillness, a faint voice was continuously echoing—Chen Xuan's voice, yet carrying unprecedented vicissitudes and exhaustion, as if traversing endless years and spacetime: "Chen Ji... you have finally arrived. Remember... the key to the seal is not within the Tianji Record... but in..." The voice cut off abruptly, as if some force had forcibly severed the transmission.
